Is there any way to speed it up if I need it sooner?

Once an order is placed, we're not able to change the shipping method or speed it up on that same order.

If you need it sooner, the option would be to place a new order with Expedited or Overnight shipping, then return the original one for a refund if you end up not needing both. 🌟

If you let me know when you placed your order and what shipping method you chose, I can help figure out if a new faster order would get to you in time!

How do I find my tracking link?

You can find your tracking link in two places:

Your shipping confirmation email, titled “Your Spanx.com order has shipped”
Your SPANX account under Order History

If you don’t see the email, check your spam or junk folder too. Once the label is created, it can take up to 24 hours for the carrier site to show tracking updates.

If you want, send your order number or the email used at checkout and I’ll help you look for it.

Can I reroute the package to a different address?

Once an order has been processed, I can’t reroute it to a different address from our side. If it has already shipped, your best option is to contact the carrier directly once tracking is active to see whether they offer rerouting. If you send your order number or checkout email, I can check whether your order is still early enough for any other option. Let me know if there's anything more I can assist with.

Sometimes, yes, depending on what’s happening with the order.
